solve:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Interactively identifies all broken servers for each test case by sending binary bit queries, reconstructing the original indices of the working servers from the judge's replies, and printing the missing indices in increasing order." solve]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> testNumber </REF>: int "The current test case number; not used by this method except to match the required interactive judge signature."
        <REF> in </REF>: java.util.Scanner "Scanner used to read the number of test cases, per-test values N, B, F, the F query response strings, and the judge's verification response."
        <REF> out </REF>: java.io.PrintWriter "PrintWriter used to output each query row, flush after each row, print the broken server indices, and flush the final answer."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the total number of test cases T from the Scanner as an integer. RESULT T]
            [COMMAND For each test case t from 1 to T inclusive, execute the following per-test-case procedure. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Within test case t, read N, B, and F from the Scanner in that order. RESULT N_B_F]
            [COMMAND Create an empty List<String> named reply to hold the F judge response rows. RESULT reply]
            [COMMAND Within test case t, for each query row i from 0 to F-1 inclusive, compute k = 1 << i; then for each server index j from 0 to N-1 inclusive, write '0' to out if (j & k) == 0 and write '1' otherwise, without any separator or newline between bits. RESULT query_row_output]
            [COMMAND After each complete query row, write a newline to out, flush out, read the next String token from in, and append it to reply. RESULT reply]
            [COMMAND Within test case t, initialize p to 0, first to true, and declare integer i for the reconstruction loop. RESULT p_first_i]
            [COMMAND Run the reconstruction loop with i starting at 0, continuing while i < N && p + B < N (with i < N evaluated before p + B < N), and with i incremented by the loop update after each iteration; in each iteration execute the next three commands. RESULT i_p]
            [COMMAND Inside the reconstruction loop, build a StringBuilder sb by appending reply.get(j).charAt(p) for j from F-1 down to 0 inclusive, then parse the resulting string as a base-2 integer and store it as val. RESULT val]
            [COMMAND Inside the reconstruction loop, if val != i, run an inner for loop while i < val: if first is false print a space, set first to false, print i, and increment i; this loop advances i to val and thereby changes the outer loop's i value. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Inside the reconstruction loop, after the val != i handling, increment p by 1. RESULT p]
            [COMMAND After the reconstruction loop exits, run a final loop starting at the current i and continuing while i < N: if first is false print a space, set first to false, print i, and increment i by 1. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND After the final loop, print a newline to out and flush out. RESULT none]
            [COMMAND Read the judge's verification integer from in and store it as judge_response. RESULT judge_response]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: At the end of a test case, after judge_response has been read, judge_response == -1.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return from solve immediately without processing any more test cases. RESULT none]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
